name: Rime Shields
permanentEffect: Your opponents cannot apply modifiers to their combat rolls during combat in a system that contains 1 or more of your structures.

name: Wardstone Doctrine
window: When a player's ships move into the active system
windowEffect: Up to 1 of your PDS units may use its SPACE CANNON ability against those ships if that PDS is connected to the active system through a continuous chain of adjacent systems that each contain 1 or more of your structures.

name: Gald-Tithe
windowEffect: You may either place 1 of your opponent's control tokens on the Blot legendary card if you won that combat or 1 of your control tokens on the Blot legendary card if you lost.

name: Thrall Conscription
window: After you win a ground combat
windowEffect: You may remove 1 control token from the Blot legendary planet card, then place up to 3 infantry from your reinforcements on that planet.

name: War Spoils
window: After you gain control of a planet that was controlled by another player
windowEffect: You may remove 1 of that player's control tokens from Blot to gain trade goods equal to that planet's resource value.

name: Take Root
window: At the end of a tactical action
windowEffect: You may place 1 root token with a trait that planet doesn't already have from your reinforcements on a planet in the active system. Planets that contain a Root token gain each trait shown on that token.

name: Communion
window: After you produce units in a system that contains a root token
windowEffect: You may either move 1 of those units to another system containing a root token; or you may produce 1 unit in a system containing a planet that contains a root token for each trait that planet has; if you do, remove a root token.

name: Old Growth
window: When a root token is placed on a planet
windowEffect: That planet's controller takes the Root card that matches the trait of that token. A player cannot have more than 1 Root card of each trait.

name: Cultural Root Card
window: When you exhaust a planet with a cultural Root token to cast votes on an agenda
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card to cast 2 additional votes for each cultural Root token on planets you control.

name: Industrial Root Card
window: When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION on a planet with an industrial Root token
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card to reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1 for each industrial Root token on planets you control.

name: Hazardous Root Card
window: At the start of a combat round in a system containing a planet with a hazardous Root token
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card to apply +1 to your combat rolls for each hazardous Root token on planets you control.

name: Chooser of the Slain
window: At the end of a combat
windowEffect: You may HALLOW 1 of your units that participated in that combat.

name: Einherjar Descent
window: When a game effect instructs a player to HALLOW a unit
windowEffect: They place a HALLOWED token beneath it if it does not have one. When this unit would be assigned a hit, remove a HALLOWED token instead.

name: Weave the Saga
window: When the Saga token is attached to a planet
windowEffect: That planet is a legendary planet, and its controller gains the Valkyrie Longhouse legendary planet ability card.
